title: helm(private): validate values.schema + init hooks rollback compat and templating fixes
author: Alex Kim
description: This PR updates the Redwood Private Helm chart to harden values schema validation, improve init hooks/templating for upgrade/rollback stability, and add compatibility fallbacks for older cluster states. Motivation: customers observed failed rollbacks and stuck init jobs when upgrading across a mixed set of CRD versions and when `private.init.enabled` toggles between releases. Changes include: 1) values.schema.json expanded with stricter types, defaults, and new conditional keys for KMS and networkPolicy to prevent silent misconfiguration; 2) templating fixes to ensure immutable fields are not changed during upgrades (serviceAccount annotations and PodSecurityPolicy selectors); 3) init job hook changes: converted several pre-install hooks to pre-upgrade/post-upgrade with backoff and idempotency markers, added a graceful-noop path when init manifests are already applied; 4) rollback compatibility: new `upgrade.rollbackCompat` flags and small migration job that runs as a post-upgrade hook to revert only safe fields when rollback is requested; 5) helm lint/unit tests and integration test matrix updates. This PR includes follow-ups items and a short migration guide in charts/private/README.md. Checklists: - [x] values schema coverage for top-level keys - [x] unit tests for template rendering - [x] e2e canary upgrade/rollback test added - [x] documented migration steps in README - [ ] follow-up to add metrics for init-hook duration (separate PR). Related Linear: ENG-4731, ENG-4750.

review_conversation: Priya Nair: Please add a note about the idempotency marker shape and why we use a ConfigMap instead of an annotation. Alex Kim: Added rationale in README and switched to ConfigMap to avoid annotation size limits.

Evan Brooks: Why is the pre-install hook moved to pre-upgrade? Concern about fresh installs. Alex Kim: For fresh installs the pre-install path remains a noop; we added explicit pre-install checks and a post-install reconciliation to cover both paths.

Marta Diaz: Can this affect Dedicated clusters where init job is managed externally? Alex Kim: We added an opt-out flag private.init.enabled=false and documented the behavior. Tests added to ensure no-op when disabled.
Priya Nair: Approve after tests green. (approved)
